meta.title: Start Awarding opens the awarding screen with proposal value summary

steps.note: Open the prepared Master QCS for the event with completed negotiation.
Click Start Awarding and enter the awarding screen.
Assert that the awarding screen renders its selection and proposal value counters.
Verify the total selected line items summary is shown.
Verify the proposal value summary is shown.
Verify the L1 proposal value summary is shown.
Verify the Non-L1 proposal value summary is shown.
